= ipfs-gate-escrow — deploy the isolated money box =

From CompleteNoobs

''Skeleton (Phase 2 of decoupling-notes/ipfs-gate-split-plan.md). The production
pass (Phase 7) folds real symptom-first entries into Common problems. The
host-hardening recipe is IDENTICAL to the proven v4call box — follow
v4call-escrow/walkthrough.wiki Steps 1–4 (patched minimal Alpine, key-only SSH,
nftables default-deny inbound, unprivileged user) and swap in the ipfs-gate
bits below.''

== What this is ==

The settlement authority for a decoupled ipfs-gate: the ONLY holder of the
escrow account's active key. The gate node (ipfs-gate-node, <code>ESCROW_MODE=box</code>)
is keyless — it sends signed claim-settle reports over Nostr (kind-31337,
escrow-protocol/0.1); this box independently re-verifies every payment
on-chain, applies the settlement cap, disburses the refund, and returns a
signed receipt. No inbound ports: outbound HTTPS (Hive RPC) + WSS (relay) only.

'''Topology guidance''' (v4call owner decision 2026-06-16, carried over): with
REAL funds, run the box on its own minimal host, separate from the node — a
node compromise then cannot drain the key. The single-server combined stack
(node + escrow as separate containers on one box, <code>--profile escrow</code> in
ipfs-gate-node's compose) is supported and fine for TEST-token dry-runs and
small self-hosted setups; understand the reduced blast-radius isolation before
putting real value on it. Never install Claude/dev tooling on a real-funds box.

== Deploy shape A — bare metal (Alpine + OpenRC; the v4call-proven path) ==

# Harden the host per v4call-escrow/walkthrough.wiki Steps 1–4.
# <code>apk add nodejs npm git python3 make g++</code> (build deps for better-sqlite3)
# Clone BOTH repos as siblings (escrow-core is a <code>file:../</code> dependency):
#: <code>git clone https://github.com/CompleteNoobs/escrow-core /opt/escrow-core</code>
#: <code>git clone https://github.com/CompleteNoobs/ipfs-gate-escrow /opt/ipfs-gate-escrow</code>
# <code>cd /opt/ipfs-gate-escrow && npm install --omit=dev</code>
# <code>cp .env.example .env</code> and fill in (see Configuration below).
# OpenRC service: copy v4call-escrow's <code>/etc/init.d/v4call-escrow</code> recipe, renaming
  v4call-escrow → ipfs-gate-escrow (the key var is IPFS_GATE_ACTIVE_KEY, read from .env).
# <code>rc-update add ipfs-gate-escrow && rc-service ipfs-gate-escrow start</code>

== Deploy shape B — Docker (NEW in the ipfs-gate decoupling) ==

# Clone both repos as siblings (as above), <code>cp .env.example .env</code>, fill in.
# <code>npm run docker:prep</code>  (vendors ../escrow-core into the build context)
# <code>docker compose up -d --build</code>
# Logs: <code>docker logs -f ipfs-gate-escrow</code>

Updates (either shape): <code>git -C /opt/escrow-core pull && git -C /opt/ipfs-gate-escrow pull</code>
then restart the service / <code>npm run docker:build && docker compose up -d</code>.

== Configuration ==

All in <code>.env</code> (see .env.example — authoritative):

* <code>ESCROW_ACCOUNT</code> — the escrow Hive account (node-side name: IPFS_GATE_HIVE_ACCOUNT).
* <code>IPFS_GATE_ACTIVE_KEY</code> — THE money key. This host only. Never on the node.
* <code>ESCROW_CURRENCY</code> + <code>ESCROW_TOKEN_PRECISION</code> — HE tokens (CNOOBS=3) are FATAL without the precision lock.
* <code>ESCROW_EXPECTED_REPORTERS</code> — fail-closed allow-list of node reporting pubkeys.
* <code>NOSTR_RELAYS</code> — default wss://nostr.v4call.com.
* <code>GUARDIAN_CANCEL_FEE_PCT</code> / <code>MIN_REFUND</code> — BOX-AUTHORITATIVE settlement
  knobs; set the node's quote-side env to the same values or quotes and
  settlements drift (the box wins).

== Wiring the two pubkeys ==

# Boot the box once — it logs <code>box reporting pubkey: &lt;64-hex&gt;</code>.
  Put that in the NODE's <code>ESCROW_BOX_PUBKEY</code>.
# Boot the node in box mode once — it logs its node reporting pubkey.
  Put that in the BOX's <code>ESCROW_EXPECTED_REPORTERS</code>. Restart both.

== Smoke checks ==

* Boot without IPFS_GATE_ACTIVE_KEY → FATAL (refuses to start).
* Boot without ESCROW_EXPECTED_REPORTERS → FATAL (fail-closed).
* Non-native currency without ESCROW_TOKEN_PRECISION → FATAL.
* <code>npm test</code> (20 box tests) and <code>npm run dry-run</code>
  (adversarial guards, "ALL GUARDS HELD") both green on the dev host
  before any deploy that will touch real value.

== Common problems ==

''(Seeded from the v4call box; Phase 7 adds ipfs-gate-specific entries as found.)''

* '''Payouts stuck pending''' — usually the key missing from .env or a Hive RPC
  outage. The 60s recovery loop retries with an on-chain memo-probe first, so a
  landed-but-lost-response refund is never double-paid; fix the cause and wait a
  cycle (or restart the service).
* '''Relay down''' — settlements stall safely: the node's drainer republishes
  until a receipt verifies; refunds stay durable-pending. Check
  <code>NOSTR_RELAYS</code> and the relay host.
* '''strfry rejects subscriptions ("filter is not an object")''' —
  pool.subscribeMany takes a SINGLE filter object, not an array (nostr-transport
  carries the note; don't "fix" it back).
